statement: Pinned nxbt intentionally sets the inactive opposite stick's three reported bytes to zero in its emulated L/R Nintendo controller state; this is a synthetic implementation choice and cannot establish the retail Joy-Con inactive-side byte invariant.

applicability.revision: joycontrol 18a09da1a04306534ff9e1df8a1a69c0192a3244 GPL-3.0; nxbt ec4b800ad6c55de96bb6c7f9f84b5bdc59a4c975 MIT; source-only
applicability.scope: Only nxbt emulation, not source support for physical inactive-stick values; see A2 No evidence.
